name: manifest
description: Manifest agent skills for Claude Code, partitioned into nine bundles, plus the adversarial-design-loop plugin. Requires the Manifest bootstrap for the shared ~/.claude/scripts and config that many skills invoke.

plugins.name: manifest-code-quality
plugins.description: Analysis of code that already exists: per-language refactor roadmaps, constitution audit, AI-defect audits, verification gates and test craft. Requires Manifest bootstrap for ~/.claude/scripts.

plugins.name: manifest-docs
plugins.description: Documentation: README and doc-set improvement, Mermaid architecture diagrams, and a one-pass orchestrator. Requires Manifest bootstrap for ~/.claude/scripts.

plugins.name: manifest-forge
plugins.description: Code-forge and issue-tracker workflows: commits, branches, PR/MR review threads, triage and autonomous issue-to-PR development. Requires Manifest bootstrap for ~/.claude/scripts.

plugins.name: manifest-graphify
plugins.description: Map a codebase, docs or repo into a queryable knowledge graph. Requires Manifest bootstrap and the graphify CLI.

plugins.name: manifest-ops
plugins.description: Runtime and deployment operations: environment config validation, deploy diagnosis, version pinning, CI pipelines and data-ingestion design. Requires Manifest bootstrap for ~/.claude/scripts.

plugins.name: manifest-security
plugins.description: Security review and hardening: diff review, finding triage and refutation, MCP and proxy audits, CI pwn-request analysis. Requires Manifest bootstrap for ~/.claude/scripts.

plugins.name: manifest-spec-planning
plugins.description: Planning artifacts: spec/plan/task consistency review, completion audit, trade-off records and critic-gated implementation. Requires Manifest bootstrap for ~/.claude/scripts.

plugins.name: manifest-workspace
plugins.description: Workspace and session tooling: environment checks, config audit, memory, plans, prompts and skill evolution. Requires Manifest bootstrap for ~/.claude/scripts.

plugins.name: manifest-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate tasks, second opinions, and reviews to Codex, Claude, or Antigravity backends with resumable follow-ups, background jobs, and an optional finish-time review gate.

plugins.name: stitch-design
plugins.description: Google Stitch design workflows: generate and edit screens, extract and manage design systems, and convert designs to React, React Native or Remotion.

plugins.name: adversarial-design-loop
plugins.description: Spec-first UI design loop: colorless screen prompts, faithful render gates, multi-lens adversarial review with skeptic-verified blockers, upstream spec amendments.
